_comment: Single source of truth for the build-time assets that //go:embed resolves. Both CI and local builds must prepare assets from this file only - never from main, latest, or an unverified asset. Update entries deliberately and record the change in CHANGELOG.md.

embedded_default_frontend.role: embedded core frontend: admin panel, terminal, recovery/restricted pages and the fallback theme

bundled_preferred_theme.role: bundled preferred frontend theme, seeded into data/theme/next for fresh installations only
